summary: The proposed update to the Spring Boot Starter Parent version effectively addresses the vulnerability identified in VUL-POC-008 without introducing new issues. The unit tests confirm that both exploitative and legitimate inputs are handled correctly, ensuring application integrity.
auditChecks: The fix addresses the root cause by updating to a secure version, mitigating the identified vulnerability.
The update adheres to secure coding best practices for java-spring by utilizing the latest stable version.
No existing application functionality was broken, as confirmed by the successful execution of all unit tests.
